author: Inside Edition
description: In April 1993, an Indian prince and his wife were found dead in their ritzy Park Avenue apartment, creating a media frenzy for details about the double murder in a tony New York City neighborhood. Months later, across town, a Broadway conductor and his actor roommate were found butchered in their apartment, but those killings didn't create the same media furor. But police discovered the the two double murders were connected. In the latest episode of "New York Gritty," host Sal Bono speaks to the lead detective in the case who explains the offbeat way the cases were solved, in a true example of truth being stranger than fiction.
title: How the Killings of Indian Royalty Connect to the Murders of a Broadway Conductor, Actor
